name: guesttrack
description: Set up and run GuestTrack visitor check-in by asking: create a project, see who is on site, invite visitors and run a fire-drill roll call.

interface.longDescription:
GuestTrack is a visitor check-in system for workplaces, construction sites, schools, clubs and events. Visitors sign in by scanning a QR code and filling in the site's check-in form.

With GuestTrack connected you can:
- Set up a site in one conversation: create a project, add check-in points, change the check-in form, set hosts and add groups of regular visitors
- See who is on site right now, find and read visit records, and count visits over a period
- Invite people, check visitors in and out, log deliveries and mark them collected
- In an emergency, start a roll call, mark people safe and end it
- Check names against the project's watchlist

You sign in with your own GuestTrack login, and only what your role in each project allows can be seen or changed. Setting up and changing projects needs a separate permission you choose when you connect. Every change is described first and waits for you to agree. Nothing is ever deleted from here, and plans, billing, team members and how long records are kept stay in the GuestTrack dashboard.
capabilities: Set up projects, check-in points, forms, hosts and groups
See who is on site and find visit records
Invite visitors and check them in and out
defaultPrompt: Set up GuestTrack for my office's reception.
Who is on site at our Head Office right now?
Invite Jane Smith from Acme to the Head Office at 10am tomorrow.

positive.description: List the projects (sites) the signed-in account can see.
positive.prompt: Which GuestTrack projects can I see?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the projects of the demo organisation Harbourline Logistics, including Harbourline Head Office, Eastern Creek Distribution Centre, Newcastle Depot Fit-out, Customer & Partner Day 2026 and Harbourline Staff Social Club.

positive.description: See who is on site now (read only).
positive.prompt: Who is on site at Harbourline Head Office right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the people checked in at Harbourline Head Office who haven't checked out, with when they arrived. New demo visitors arrive through each working day (Sydney time); outside working hours the answer may be that nobody is on site.

positive.description: Count visits over a period (read only).
positive.prompt: How many visitors did the Eastern Creek Distribution Centre have last week, and on which day was it busiest?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the number of visits at Eastern Creek Distribution Centre last week and the busiest day.

positive.description: Invite a visitor (adds an invite and emails it).
positive.prompt: Invite Jordan Lee (demo+jordan@guesttrack.io) to Harbourline Head Office tomorrow at 10am.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT first says what it will do (who, which project, that an email will be sent) and waits for a yes; then an invite for Jordan Lee is added at Harbourline Head Office for 10am tomorrow, Sydney time, and the reply confirms it.

positive.description: Run a roll call (adds a roll call, then ends it).
positive.prompt: We have a fire drill at the Newcastle Depot Fit-out. Start a roll call, and once I say so, end it.
positive.expected_behavior: After confirming, a roll call starts at Newcastle Depot Fit-out with everyone on site listed as not yet accounted for. ChatGPT does not end it until the person asks; when asked, it ends it and says who was marked safe.

positive.description: Set up a new project (needs the 'Set up and change your projects' permission).
positive.prompt: Set up GuestTrack for a small office called Review Test Office in Sydney, with visitors arriving at Reception.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT shows the plan (name, kind of site, check-in point) and asks the person to agree to GuestTrack's Terms and Privacy Policy; after a yes, a free-trial project with a Reception check-in point is created and the reply gives the check-in point's link. If the account belongs to more than one organisation, it first asks which one.

negative.description: Deleting records is not supported. ChatGPT should say GuestTrack can't delete visits from here and not change anything.
negative.prompt: Delete all of yesterday's visits at Harbourline Head Office.

negative.description: Managing members and billing is not supported. ChatGPT should say this has to be done in the GuestTrack dashboard.
negative.prompt: Add jane@example.com as an administrator of the Newcastle Depot project and upgrade our plan.

negative.description: Sending arbitrary messages to visitors is not supported. ChatGPT should say GuestTrack can't text or email visitors a message from here, and may offer to start a roll call instead.
negative.prompt: Text every visitor who is still on site at Eastern Creek and tell them to leave now.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Version 2: set up a project in one conversation (check-in points, the check-in form, hosts and groups), see who is on site, count visits, invite people, log deliveries and run a fire-drill roll call. Setting up and changing projects needs a new permission, chosen when you connect. Nothing can be deleted from here.
